I wrote the RPN calculator in `main.wj`. It compiles with `wj build` and gives the expected output on every case I ran.

I ran both examples from the task, plus `-7 2 /`, which printed `-3` (truncation toward zero). A blank line was skipped, and a lone `-` printed `error: underflow`.

I didn't test other cases, such as a negative operand next to an operator or very large values near the 64-bit lim
